items.text: #AZ01: This Saturday, January 15th, is the FINAL deadline for Marketplace Open Enrollment. Don't miss your chance to enroll or change your coverage for 2022! Get started at https://t.co/gxpPTHKtI5 to find the plan that works best for your family. https://t.co/fC2ZB4ET4E

January is #NationalEyeCareMonth. Eye exams are a critical part of regular health care, especially for #AZ01 seniors. Last year, I re-introduced my legislation to expand Medicare coverage to provide affordable vision care like routine eye exams and eyeglasses. https://t.co/N1OG6uAzTP

#AZ01 seniors have paid into Medicare their entire lives, and I will always work to protect the affordable care it provides. I joined my colleagues on a letter urging CMS reevaluate its decision to raise premiums by 14.5% to spare seniors from undue financial hardship. https://t.co/Rsg4dLr3Ht
Proud to join my colleagues in the Arizona delegation in this effort to ensure @UAZCancer can continue its lifesaving cancer research and treatment for patients across #AZ01

National Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day highlights the importance of increased access to prevention, care, & treatment in addressing the impact of HIV on Black communities. Today, we recognize the progress we've made, but we must stand committed to the work ahead. #NBHAAD #AZ01 https://t.co/xGtjReIbEA

March is #NationalKidneyMonth. 1 in 9 adults has kidney disease & over the last year, many have faced new barriers to the care they need. My bill expands Medicare to ensure #AZ01 seniors with chronic kidney disease are able to receive effective treatment safely, at home. https://t.co/OdB5HrhPpq

March is #NationalNutritionMonth! I'm proud to support the Streamlining Nutrition Assistance Paperwork Act: commonsense legislation to cut red tape for SNAP applicants so more #AZ01 families can get the food they need, faster.

Today, on National Native HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, we recognize the unique and disproportionate impact of HIV and AIDS in tribal communities. We must all stand committed to increasing access to testing, preventative care, and treatment for HIV. #AZ01 https://t.co/XjUw31cA0c

April is National Cancer Control Month. Cancer is the second leading cause of death in America, and we must continue working to provide the necessary resources to support cancer research, prevention, and treatment. #AZ01

Today, we celebrate 57 years of #HeadStart, a program that has served millions of kids and vastly improved access to early childhood education, nutrition, and health in #AZ01. Ensuring programs like these have the support and funding they need is one of my top priorities. https://t.co/lVfRixEZ4K

Vision care is an essential component of health care, but far too often, #AZ01 seniors aren't getting the routine care they need. My Medicare Vision Act would expand Medicare coverage and ensure affordable access to routine eye exams, eyeglasses, and more. https://t.co/f5rUSXU5hK

Over the past few years, our rural health and trauma centers have been stretched thin, working tirelessly to care for Arizonans in crisis. I introduced bipartisan legislation to ensure rural #AZ01 communities are fully equipped to respond to emergencies. https://t.co/BzHjDx1DXF

Over 60K #AZ01 seniors are enrolled in Medicare Advantage—including me—but in rural communities, providers are far too often out of reach. We need data transparency to ensure seniors have the info they need to make critical decisions about their health care plan. https://t.co/n4A2as6xhG

For over five decades, Medicare has expanded the quality and accessibility of health care for #AZ01 seniors. Today, as we celebrate 56 years since Medicare began, I'm reaffirming my commitment to protecting this critical program and the care it provides.

Last week, I visited the North Country Health Care Show Low Clinic to talk with doctors, nurses, and staff and hear what's needed to support their work and ensure they can continue serving rural #AZ01 families. https://t.co/nJBPBxVDGI

Access to reliable housing is critical for the safety, health, and long-term success of our #AZ01 veterans. I introduced new legislation to cut red tape, expand the HUD-VASH program, and address the high rates of veteran homelessness we’re seeing in our communities. https://t.co/kNZz8Ab27h

In recent weeks, #AZ01 doctors & patients have been left in limbo as private health care decisions are debated in Arizona's court system. Today, I voted to pass two bills to protect women's access to essential health care. Now, the Senate must do the same. https://t.co/oPmX9nuSI2

Last Congress, I cosponsored a bill to establish a nationwide suicide hotline, 988. As of this weekend, that hotline is live. Arizonans experiencing a mental health crisis can now call or text 988 for 24/7 support and counseling. #AZ01 https://t.co/0q0RscMOBe
